name: Kat Vada
steps: Cook 120 g onion, coconut and half the ginger-garlic paste in 35 ml oil until brown; blend with tomatoes and 300 ml water. Return to pan with Kolhapuri masala, 6 g salt and 400 ml water; simmer 20 minutes into a thin fiery kat rassa.

Temper mustard and curry leaves in a little hot frying oil; add remaining onion, ginger-garlic paste, chopped chillies and turmeric. Cook 4 minutes, mash with potatoes and 3 g salt, then shape 12 balls.
Keep the kat rassa barely simmering while you fry the vadas; the gravy should reach the bowl piping hot.
Whisk gram flour with remaining water and salt into thick batter. Dip potato balls and fry at 175°C for 4–5 minutes until golden. Put three vadas in each bowl and pour hot kat around them.
tips: Pour kat at serving time so the vadas keep a little crisp edge.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
